parts.name: Rotation Blade
parts.Basic_description: This is the rotation blade of the knife, made of stainless steel. It is a thin, sharp component designed for cutting.
parts.Functional_description: The blade performs the cutting function of the knife. It can rotate or fold into the handle for safety and portability.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around a pivot point to fold into or extend from the base body.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or handle of the knife, made of durable plastic. It provides grip and houses the rotating blade.
parts.Functional_description: The base body allows the user to hold and control the knife safely. It also contains the pivot mechanism for the blade.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while the blade rotates or folds into it.
